article.title: If You Want to Win, Learn to Think From Other People’s Perspective
article.author: Chris Brooks
article.content: A Necker cube does something interesting if you look at it long enough. The image stays the same, but the cube suddenly flips. One minute the left side looks closest to you, then the next moment it looks further away. The underlying facts never change. The lines remain exactly in the same place. What changes is how you perceive those lines. Differences in perspective come up all the time… Source
